decision.summary: The current Skill did not improve judgment-heavy cases, did not prevent a critical rendered-structure change, and produced stable false activations. It reproducibly improved one Japanese styled-node spacing case, but that behavior is deterministic, absent from the Skill contract, and better assigned to explicit static rules.
decision.adoption: The maintainer accepted retirement on 2026-07-29 and deferred replacement design.
decision.next_step: Remove the current Skill. If a distributed replacement is reconsidered later, decide separately whether deterministic rules belong in a bundled checker or each consumer repository's configured tools. Do not adopt the temporary tool configuration as a universal policy.

supports_retirement: No-Skill and current-Skill Codex were equal on all three judgment or mixed-authority cases.
Both agent conditions made the same critical rendered-structure change during mechanical normalization.
The static condition preserved rendered structure, preserved prose wrapping, and surfaced the marker conflict instead of auto-fixing it.
The current description produced stable false activations for toolchain design and an unclaimed Japanese spacing rule.
evidence_against_immediate_retirement: The current Skill condition reproducibly completed styled-node boundary spacing that no-Skill Codex missed in two matched observations.
decision_evidence.resolution: The observed improvement is a deterministic spacing behavior, is not specified by the current Skill body, and coincides with an imprecise trigger. It supports evaluating additional explicit textlint rules or a style configuration, not retaining the current mixed Skill.
